topic: Redirecting old site and QR codes
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on redirecting an old website to opt-out.allunite.com. A key concern raised was that changing the URL would invalidate existing QR codes, which have been printed and placed on screens for at least two years.

The proposed solution involves implementing a specific redirect: `allunite.com/r/<alias>` must point to `opt-out.allunite.com/r/<alias>`. This process is noted as being complex because the `allunite.com/r/` structure is an internal WordPress function.
decisions: The old site will be moved and redirected to opt-out.allunite.com.
action_items: Someone needs to implement the specific redirect from allunite.com/r/<alias> to opt-out.allunite.com/r/<alias>.
